basic_details.job_title: RCB Administrative Officer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Regional Centre for Biotechnology (RCB) has announced 1 vacancy for the Administrative Officer post on a contract basis under advertisement number RCB/IBDC/01/2026/Rectt./HR. The engagement is initially valid until the current duration of the project on 31 March 2027, with consolidated emoluments up to Rs. 56,166 based on relevant experience and qualification. Candidates applying for the post must possess a BBA with 5 years' experience or an MBA(Finance)/ CA/ ICWA with 3 years' experience, along with IT skills and knowledge of Govt Financial Rules and PFMS. Eligible applicants can apply online

how_to_apply: Visit the official RCB website at www.rcb.res.in to access the online application form.
Fill out the online application form with the required personal and professional details.
Pay the requisite non-refundable application fee of Rs. 200/- online (SC/ST/PwD/Women candidates are exempted from fee payment).
Submit the online application latest by 28th October 2026. Applications received through any other mode will not be accepted.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must fulfil the essential qualification and experience requirements stipulated for the position: Essential Qualification: B.Com/ BBA with 5 years’ experience in accounts & finance in a reputed organization OR M.Com/ MBA(Finance)/ CA/ ICWA with 3 years’ experience in accounts & finance in a reputed organization. Additional Requirements: Must have IT skills and knowledge of Govt Financial Rules and PFMS. Age Limit: 40 Years, with age relaxation as per GoI norms available to eligible applicants. In all other cases, if a candidate is otherwise suitable, age/experience relaxation may be granted by the Competent Authority.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The post carries monthly consolidated emoluments up to Rs. 56,166/- based on the relevant experience of the candidate. The consolidated emoluments are fixed, and an annual increment is applicable upon the completion of one year of satisfactory services subject to the extension of the project duration. No other perks or allowances are admissible. The contract is initially valid until 31 March 2027 and may be extended further subject to approvals. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? content_sections.heading: How to Apply for RCB Administrative Officer
content_sections.text: Visit the official RCB website at www.rcb.res.in to access the online application form. Fill out the online application form with the required personal and professional details. Pay the requisite non-refundable application fee of Rs. 200/- online (SC/ST/PwD/Women candidates are exempted from fee payment). Submit the online application latest by 28th October 2026. Applications received through any other mode will not be accepted.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Mere fulfilment of the minimum prescribed qualification and experience does not vest any right on a candidate to be called for the selection process. Only candidates shortlisted by a duly constituted Screening Committee will be called for the selection process, and the decision of the Centre in this regard is final.

faq.question: Q1. Is this position permanent or contractual?
faq.answer: The position is strictly contractual and initially valid until the current duration of the project on 31 March 2027, which may be extendable subject to approvals.

faq.question: Q2. Who is exempted from paying the application fee?
faq.answer: SC, ST, PwD, and Women candidates are exempted from the payment of the Rs. 200/- application fee.

faq.question: Q3. How are candidates shortlisted for the selection process?
faq.answer: Only candidates shortlisted by a duly constituted Screening Committee will be called for the selection process, based on their qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q4. Can serving government employees apply for this position?
faq.answer: Persons working in Government or Public Sector Undertakings should apply through the proper channel or produce a 'No-Objection Certificate' at the time of the selection process.
